rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Connects to Deveras website quality scanners for accessibility auditing, AI search engine optimization analysis, and AI agent security verification. Provides tools to scan any URL for WCAG violations with severity-graded results, check AI engine optimization readiness, verify robots.txt and ai.txt compliance signals, estimate EU Accessibility Act compliance, and generate framework-specific code fix recipes for React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and Next.js.
